outcome.technical: DESIGN: the step lives in the tier computation. hooks/_config.py: manifest_state() now returns hasPhases (any phase dict in the assembled manifest, set before the running-phase early return); new PLAN_GATE_LADDER table ((no-manifest, observe), (no-phase, warn), (nothing-running, deny), (phase-running, deny)); new plan_gate_step(cfg, state) -> 'planGate' | 'enforce' | a ladder step (a hand-built state without hasPhases reads as no-phase, so old callers keep their tier; never raises); plan_gate_mode now reads its tier off the ladder through plan_gate_step (pin and enforce still win first); new plan_gate_cause(cfg, state, manifest_rel), the single copy of the deny cause sentence, with a nothing-running sentence ('The plan in <manifest> holds phases, but no phase is in_progress, so an edit past this session's free file is refused before it lands.'). Docstrings updated (ladder table, enforce key reference). hooks/require-plan.py: the deny branch takes its cause from _config.plan_gate_cause; on the nothing-running step the orchestrator-facing refusal names '/audit:phase add "<title>" --outcome "<what success is>"' then '/audit:phase <the id add printed>' (plus /audit:next, the human bypass, exempt list); the subagent refusal is unchanged apart from the correct cause; warn-branch comment rewritten (warn now only for a manifest with no phase, or a pin). Step 5 (free file) runs before the tier, so it is untouched; a non-edit tool returns 'unknown tool' before any of this. An oversized FIRST file is also refused on this step (it is not the free file - the free file is the first SMALL one, as on every deny tier).
